These rules over rule all of the previous rules put in place.

General

You may not rule/own multiple countries. If you are caught using alts, you will be banned from the SubVoat.

Link posts are not allowed, only self posts. Links will be deleted.

Do not break the site rules, or harass other players. This includes racism, trolling, ect.

Do not lie to the moderators. It ruins the game for everyone.

Do not be rude to admins / Abuse admins

We run on a warning system, if you receive 3 warnings you will be kicked from this SubVoat.

You cannot react to something said out of game or in [META] you can only react to posts made on the record.

'Invading' a unoccupied country is counted as a expansion.

Inactivity

If you don't make a post in seven days you will be deemed inactive and your country will become available again. On the chance that you say you are going to be inactive beforehand, the mods will make a case depending on your nation’s size how long they will let you be inactive - this will be greatly increased if you have a Second In Command.

Claim

Before you claim a place on the map you must check that it is unclaimed by either checking the map, google doc or scroll through to see if anyone has taken it. You are required to have atleast 3 days on your account before you join this SubVoat, and you must read these rules. If your claim is denied you must wait 24 hours before making another claim post. A admin will accept your request if you follow the claim template found here: https://voat.co/v/WorldDiplomacy/comments/114993

Expansion

You can only expand to 1 country, no matter the size. Before you expand you must have to be a member of the SubVoat for 1 week, and expanding takes 1 week to undertake. You must need a good reason to expand or it will be denied. If your expansion is denied you must wait 48 hours before making another expansion post. 'Invading' a unoccupied country is counted as a expansion.

You may not claim Antarctica, the North Pole, or anything off of Earth's surface unless you roleplay to it and it is accepted by a mod.

Realism

You must act in a realistic manner, doing things within your country's capacity and acting realistically when confronted with threats to your nation's security. A large part of this is metagaming, and not passing laws for the fun of it - or - at least without a build up. Otherwise, it will incite a crisis for your nation.

Covert Operations

Covert Operations will be decided with a Random Number Generator. Until we can get an equivalent of rollme, the mods will use dice/random.org to decide.

War / Conflict

Before you go into war you must message an admin asking if that is a good enough reason, if you did not request this from a admin the post will be deleted asap. This also counts for decisions that can effect the entire gameplay.

When refering to nuclear weapons use this site: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_states_with_nuclear_weapons

When refering to military force use this site: http://www.globalfirepower.com/ (just type in (country) military firepower)

Flairs

Posts must use one of these link flairs.

[CLAIM] Claim your nation. [EVENT] Take action! [EXPANSION] (You can only expand into unclaimed nations, otherwise you must declare war.) [NEWS] This tag is for news and roleplay about happenings in your nations, Sundays are News days only.) [CONFLICT] Declare War! [DIPLOMACY] Make relations and trade with other countries. [SECRET] Use this for events you want to stay secret, if you really want it to be a secret feel free to message a admin about it so we can be aware if you reference it later. [CRISIS] Mod tag only. [U.N.] United Nations voting posts, only to be used by mods/leader of the United Nations. [META] Off topic discussions. No metagaming! [MODPOST] Mod tag only. Used to tell updates about the sub.
